name: Kaufman's Shaded Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering method designed to provide an informative representation of volumetric data for scientists/engineers rather than a physically accurate realistic image. It allows user modification of shading parameters to highlight features.
summary: Kaufman's Shaded Volume Rendering is a direct volume ray casting technique that decouples shading from physical realism to highlight features via a simplified intensity model with solid texture maps.
